limitations: Source assertions only; item-level uncertainties retained.

patient_identity.statement: Patient 2 matches sex, age at final assessment and clinical history: female, 3.5 years, pregnancy complicated by pre-eclampsia/IUGR.

genotype.statement: Source reports heterozygous c.802T>C/p.Tyr268His on NM_015560.3; packet uses NM_130837.3 with a +165 cDNA/+55 protein offset. A separate paternal c.381G>A/p.Pro127Pro synonymous allele, classified likely benign by authors, is omitted.
limitations: The transcript offset is consistent but equivalence/genomic normalization has not been independently sequence-validated.

segregation.statement: Source calls the missense variant de novo after trio analysis and Sanger confirmation; Figure2 shows variant in child and reference parental traces.

phase.statement: Single de novo heterozygous candidate does not require a recessive trans-phase inference. Phase with the paternal synonymous allele is not reported.
limitations: No parent-of-origin or haplotype phase measurement reported.

causal_confidence.statement: Authors classify the missense variant pathogenic and connect it to severe Leigh-like encephalomyopathy using de novo occurrence, conserved GTPase residues, patient fibroblasts and a yeast chimera.
limitations: Two-patient source report; assays/model and author ACMG interpretation are not an independent clinical truth determination. Packet disease label does not substitute for source differential diagnosis.

phenotype_completeness.statement: Every frozen phenotype including negatives and onset was compared. Packet omits MRI distribution/progression, evoked potentials and some biochemical detail; gastrostomy/ventilation and the synonymous allele also need contextual retention.

limitations: NM_130837.3 descriptor and hg38 position not directly printed in source for this allele; transcript/coordinate conversion not independently verified.
